outcome: RFP response, part 1: the PM works through the RFP's requirements inside the RFP frame, and accepts, edits or replaces each of Tola's suggested answers (contract mock only)
acceptance_criteria: **Frame from `rfp`.** On `/work/W-3401` at 1440 the page shows the RFP frame: eyebrow "Pre-sale / RFP · TL-RFP-2026-014", the one h1 "Tamarind Loans · loan origination RFP", "DEADLINE 28 NOV · 16 DAYS", "PM Tunde Bello", and the tabs in returned order. Requirements has `aria-current="page"` and is not a link. Team input links to `/work/W-3401/respond?task=T-3401`. Pricing, Submission and Outcome are plain text, not focusable. A "History" link goes to `/work/W-3401/history`. On `/work/W-3401/respond?task=T-3401`, Team input is current and Requirements links to `/work/W-3401`. At 390 there is no frame; the header shows the title and the deadline tag, and the back link reads "← Queue". — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/rfp-requirements.test.tsx`; pages at 1440 and 390.

**Rows, progress and Tola from data.** W-3401 shows R-01 to R-06, each with its requirement, "RFP p.N", answer and status tag as returned, "6 of 64" in the inert toolbar, the three Progress figures with their note, Tola's note labelled as Tola's, and the "Before review" checklist with Engineering and QA done (date and file as returned) and "Record" on Security and Product. No board string is in `src` (`grep -rn "38 of 64\|NEEDS CLARIFICATION\|SUGGESTED BY TOLA\|Harmattan" frontend/src` returns nothing). A copy with a different figure value shows that value; nothing on the page counts rows. — verify: component tests on the fixture and on modified copies.

**Unknown never 0; no price.** A copy whose "Requirements answered" figure has no value shows "Unknown", never "0" or a blank. A copy with no `total` shows no "of" count. No "₦", amount, rate or costing version appears on any F-37 page (`document.body.textContent` checked on W-3401 to W-3404). — verify: component tests on modified copies.

**Send for review only as returned.** "Send for review" is a disabled button with the returned reason "Available once every requirement has an answer and all four teams have given input." and its consequence. It has no href, and pressing it, or pressing Enter on it, sends no request. A copy without the step draws no button. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch`.

**Record links to the team-input form.** "Record" on Security and Product goes to F-18's form for T-3401 (`/work/W-3401/respond?task=T-3401`), or opens F-31's drawer if F-31 is on the base (Conflicts 5). Engineering and QA have no Record. W-3404 (`you_can_act: false`, no steps) draws no Record, no Add and no Send. — verify: component tests; e2e at 1440 follows the link and sees F-18's form inside the frame.

**Add a requirement.** "Add a requirement from the RFP" opens the step form with Requirement and RFP page, both required as returned. Submitting sends one POST `/api/v1/work/W-3401/steps` that validates against the generated request schema: `step: "add_requirement"`, `inputs {requirement (trimmed), rfp_page: <integer>}`, a UUID `idempotency_key`, no `item_ids`. An empty field names itself and sends nothing. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch`.

**Accept one.** On W-3402 the side panel shows R-07's requirement, Tola's answer labelled "Suggested by Tola", the past-answer line as returned (with no "that bid was won"), the suggested status, the consequence and three buttons: "Accept answer", "Edit answer", "Write my own". Pressing "Accept answer" sends exactly one POST with `{expected_revision: <workspace.revision>, step: "accept", item_ids: ["R-07"], idempotency_key}` and CSRF, with no `inputs`. A double press sends one. The page re-reads, the notice reads "R-07 accepted under your name.", the R-07 row shows ADDRESSED, and the panel holds R-08, all from `W-3402.next.accept`. Before the re-read lands, the R-07 row keeps "SUGGESTED BY TOLA". — verify: component tests with a recording `fetch`; `GET /__mock/workspace-log`.

**Accept selected sends only the ticked rows.** Ticking R-07 and R-09 shows "2 selected", and "Accept selected" sends `item_ids: ["R-07", "R-09"]` with `step: "accept_selected"`. The select-all header ticks exactly the four rows shown (`aria-label` "Select all shown rows", mixed state when one to three are ticked) and never sends a filter or a count. With nothing ticked "Accept selected" is inert. A mock call naming R-01 (no `accept_selected` on it) → 422 `item_ids`. After 200 the re-read shows R-07 and R-09 accepted and R-08 and R-10 still suggested. — verify: component tests; `rfp-requirements-mock.test.ts`.

**Edit and accept.** "Edit answer" opens the form with Your answer filled with Tola's text and Status on "Addressed", both from the item's `values`. The submit reads "Save and accept". Changing the text and Status to "Clarify" sends `step: "edit_accept"`, `item_ids: ["R-07"]`, `inputs {answer: <typed, trimmed>, status: "clarify"}`. Cancel with no change closes at once and sends nothing. Cancel or Escape after a change asks "Discard your changes?": "Keep editing" returns to the form with the text, and "Discard" closes it with focus on "Edit answer". Neither sends a request. A copy without `values` opens the form empty. — verify: component tests.

**Write my own.** "Write my own" opens the form with "Tola's suggestion (not used)" and Tola's text shown read-only, an empty Your answer, the optional reason with the returned help, and Status. The submit reads "Save my answer". Pressing it empty names Your answer and sends nothing. Filled, it sends `step: "write_own"`, `inputs {answer, status, reason}`; with the reason empty, `reason` is absent. The suggestion text is never in the body. The page never shows the reason anywhere a client would see it, and it shows no sentence saying Tola learns from it. — verify: component tests; `grep -rn "suggest better next time" frontend/src frontend/mock` returns nothing.
**Failures never say accepted.** For each of the four steps:

**Uncertain step.** On W-3403, "Accept answer" answers `effect_uncertain`. The page shows the "being checked" notice, every step is off, a reload keeps them off, and exactly one `accept` request is in the mock log. — verify: component test; e2e.

**Agent text is only displayed.** Tola's note, the "Suggested by Tola" rows and the suggested answer appear exactly as returned and labelled as Tola's. Nothing marks them verified or counts them as answered before an accept's re-read. A copy with the suggestion `restricted: true` shows "Restricted" and none of its text, past-answer line or buttons. — verify: component tests on `document.body.textContent` and on modified copies.

**401, 403, 404.** 401 on the read or any write → signed-out with `next=/work/<id>`. 403 and 404 on W-3401 to W-3404 look the same, with no reference, client, title, answer or name. Persona `none` gets the not-open view with no further call. — verify: component tests with a recording `fetch`.

**Nothing from `/me`.** No control, name, tab link or status comes from `/me` or a role. The same fixture gives the same controls for personas `pm`, `finance_lead` and `ceo`. A copy with the steps removed draws none. — verify: `git diff` adds no `useMe` or `/api/v1/me` reference under `features/workspace`, `features/work-item` or `features/rfp`; component tests with three personas.

**Phone.** At 390 each page is one column with the same sections in the same order as desktop (Conflicts 13). The table stacks with its labels. "Edit answer", "Write my own" and "Add a requirement from the RFP" open the full-height `Drawer` with the desktop form's fields and outcomes. Escape and Cancel close it (after the discard question when changed) and return focus to the button. There is no sideways scroll. Every button, checkbox label, row control, tab and link outside running text is at least 44px (D-92c). — verify: e2e at 390, measuring target boxes.

**Fidelity (D-64, D-83).** One design-fidelity run per round over all 8 boards, on a production build: the two live default URLs, plus the six driver-frozen pages for review, edit and reject. For every board, coverage after approved exceptions is 100%, and visual is at least 90 or a board-level D-83 waiver (floor 70) is signed in `fidelity-exceptions.json` citing the shared frame. Every exception has `role`, `name`, `category`, `reason` and `approved_by`, and maps to a Conflicts number. None covers a value the data can supply (an answer, a tag, a count, a name, a date). — verify: the fidelity command per board (`--width 1440` and `--width 390`); `round-<N>/fidelity/`; re-run of `drive-states.mjs`.

**Accessibility.** No axe violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`) at 1440 and 390. Checked on W-3401 to W-3404, the open edit form, the open write-own form, the discard question, a 422 in each form, the uncertain state, the not-open view and the empty workspace. Every field and checkbox is labelled. Errors are announced. Status words are in text, not colour only. Focus is visible and stays in the open Drawer. Nothing animates under `reducedMotion: 'reduce'`. — verify: `e2e/rfp-requirements.spec.ts`.

**Tokens and components only.** `git diff` adds no `#hex`, `rgb(` or `hsl(` in any CSS, and no local copy of a component `@/components` exports. The phone forms use the shared `Drawer`. The discard question uses `Callout` and `Button`. — verify: grep on the diff.

**Mock matches the contract.** `rfp-requirements-mock.test.ts` checks that every new fixture validates against the generated E-WORK-ITEM schema after the overlay is stripped. It checks that every `steps.json` 200 body validates against the E-WORK-STEP 200 schema, the `.next.<step>` rule (and that F-28's audience rule still wins), the `item_ids` 422, the uncertain script, and that reset clears. — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/rfp-requirements.test.tsx tests/rfp-requirements-mock.test.ts tests/mock-contract.test.ts tests/workspace.test.tsx tests/workspace-step.test.tsx tests/workspace-mock.test.ts tests/work-item.test.tsx tests/work-item-board.test.tsx`.

**Contract not extended.** `git diff --stat` shows no change in `frontend/src/api/**`, `apps/**`, `architecture/**`, `design/**`, `src/shell/**`, `src/features/response/**`, any existing fixture or the protected paths. The only new fields are the two overlay proposals (`values` choice prefill, `submit_label`), each listed as a contract proposal in build.md with G-26-1/-2/-3. — verify: `git diff --stat`; build.md.

**Existing F-18 RFP tests and the rest kept green.** `delivery/checks.sh` passes. `tests/rfp.test.tsx`, `tests/rfp-mock.test.ts`, `tests/response.test.tsx`, `tests/response-mock.test.ts` and the e2e `rfp` and `response` specs pass unchanged. Requirements stays plain text on W-2101 and W-2103, and Team input still links to `/work/W-2103` there. The F-17, F-23 and F-30 tests and e2e under Context also pass unchanged: no assertion is edited, skipped or loosened. — verify: `checks.sh` output and the e2e output in build.md; `git diff --stat frontend/tests frontend/e2e` shows only new files.

risk.rationale: Medium. The page has several behaviours: three per-row writes plus a bulk write on the shared F-17 step path, edits to the shared F-18 `RfpFrame`, and fields that are proposals only (G-26-1, -2 and -3 are additive), hence `contract-change`. It is not high because this part moves no money, sends nothing outside, changes no authority and runs on the mock only. The answers are internal until review, and each accept is recorded under the PM's name. PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is required because the accept, edit and write-own flows and their wording are new to the client.

findings.summary: `WorkItemOverview.tsx` (`rfpPage`) drops every task panel on desktop for any `rfp_response` item that has `rfp`, not just the team-input task the tab and Record reach. An actionable task of another kind (a decision task) would have no entry point. Expected: hide only tasks with `response.variant === 'team_input'` that the frame links to, as `RfpFrame` already selects them.

`Sections.tsx` changes "Suggested by <agent>" for every line: it now shows whenever a tag label lacks the agent's name, where before any tag hid it. Only W-2002 is affected today and it still hides it, but this is not scoped to rfp_response. Gate it on the line, or note it for the F-30 and F-31 owners.

`StepForm.tsx` choice prefill from `initial` applies to every line that passes `itemValues` (F-23, F-30, F-31). It is correct, but unscoped, and no other line has a test for it. The same goes for `inSide` moving figures and checklist to the side column: it applies to W-2002 and W-2006, and their tests pass.

`RfpFrame.tsx`: when the person has no actionable team-input task (for example W-3404), Team input falls back to `work(target)`, a link to the page you are already on. Draw it as plain text, or leave it as the page did before.
`Workspace.tsx` `sideNote` and the `ws-side` condition repeat `RFP_LINE && !phone` four times. One local `rfpDesktop` would be simpler.

Record team input drawer at 1440 (height 844): the "Record input" button sits over the Note field, so the field is cut off until you scroll. Shared F-18/F-31 drawer, not part-1 code. Seen in a screenshot, not confirmed at other heights.
The Add requirement empty-field message reads "Add rfp page to continue." (lowercase "rfp", built from the field label). Expected "Add the RFP page to continue." Shared StepForm.

Phone, W-3402: a red "RECORD TEAM INPUT" card says "Only a PM can decide. You are PM." above the table, which desktop does not draw. It repeats the Record buttons and the wording is unhelpful. The phone header also shows "revision 7", a technical detail.
Phone: the select-all row is an empty bordered box with a lone checkbox, with no visible label. The accessible name is "Select all shown rows". A visible "Select all" would be clearer.

After "Accept selected" or a single accept, the "N selected" count carries over (4 selected, then 3 selected after R-07 is accepted) while the accepted row stays in the list. Fixture-driven but could confuse. Clearing the ticks after a successful write would be safer.

"Accept selected" is drawn as a second blue primary button on the review, edit and reject pages. The board draws it as an outlined secondary button beside "1 selected", and spec.md line 92 does not mark `accept_selected` as primary (only `accept` is). Expected: `emphasis: "secondary"` (or no emphasis), so "Accept answer" is the only primary in view. Actual: `frontend/mock/fixtures/work/W-3402.json:181` (and the same step in W-3403/W-3404) has `"emphasis": "primary"`.

On the desktop default board Tola's note is in the wrong place and below the fold. The board draws Progress, then Tola's note, then Before review and Send for review in the right column. The page draws Progress, Before review, Decide, and only then Tola's note, at y≈1490 against y≈506 on the board (report.json "misplaced": Text "Tola"). Expected: the note directly after the Progress section in the side column. Actual: `frontend/src/features/workspace/Workspace.tsx:~822` appends `<AgentNote>` after all the side sections.

The review, edit and reject boards draw only the filtered table and the "Review Tola's suggestion" panel, and spec.md line 92 (W-3402) lists only `table` and `suggestions`. The fixtures also return Tola's note and the "Before review" checklist, which add about 800px to the side column on desktop and two more sections on phones. These are the "extra" items in the three desktop review-state reports and a large part of their visual gap (71.0, 71.0, 70.5). Expected: those sections left out of W-3402, W-3403 and W-3404, or Conflicts updated to say they are wanted. Actual: `frontend/mock/fixtures/work/W-3402.json:170` (`agent_note`) and `:466` (`before_review`); W-3403 `:170`, `:466`; W-3404 `:170`, `:394`.

The review panel shows "Tola" twice and its "Status" exception has the wrong reason. (a) The panel's name line shows "Tola" (`Sections.tsx:500`, `section.agent`). This round's change at `Sections.tsx:354` adds "Suggested by Tola" under the item whenever the tag label does not contain the agent's name, so "Tola" appears twice. The board shows neither line; it shows a "Tola's suggested answer" heading above the answer box. Expected: one attribution only. (b) On SCR-26-desktop-review and SCR-26-mobile-review, the board draws a "Status" control in the panel before any form opens (Addressed / Clarify / Out of scope). The page draws a returned "ADDRESSED" tag instead. The exception's reason ("field labels are drawn by the shared step form") is only true on the edit and reject boards. Expected: a separate exception under its own Conflicts item that names the missing status control on the review panel, so the design engineer signs it knowingly.

Phone stacked table: status tags stretch across the value column (measured 204px live at 390, against compact tags on the board and 136px on desktop). The select-box cell also leaves a short loose rule under each checkbox. Cause: `.ws-table--stack td[data-label] { display: grid; … }` at `frontend/src/features/workspace/workspace.css:169` stretches the tag. Expected: tags at their natural width (for example, `justify-items: start` on the value cell) and no loose rule. This rule is shared, so check the F-30 and F-31 stacked tables after the change.
